_notes: Sheet 2 of the tournament savegame (8x4, CardIDs 200-229), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-22 (Ivan's save: CustomDeck key 2 of the Blackbeard deck). The deck object holds 32 cards: the 30 playing cards, the loose rules card 500 (sheet 5, one image) and the character card 362 (sheet 3, 10x7, index 62). Order on the sheet: Brace 0-1, Avast Ye 2-3, Give No Quarter 4-6, Light the Fuse 7-9, Queen Anne's Revenge 10-11, Fearsome and Calculating 12-14, Show a Leg 15-16, No Prey No Pay 17-19, Parley 20-22, Intimidating Visage 23-24, Plunder 25-27, Scourge 28-29.

Restrictions read from the card backs: BLACKBEARD (Brace, Avast Ye, Queen Anne's Revenge, Fearsome and Calculating, Intimidating Visage, Plunder, Scourge), SEA DOG (Light the Fuse), ANY (Give No Quarter, Show a Leg, No Prey No Pay, Parley). Titles are spelled as printed; unmatched-memory writes them in sentence case (memory_title).

Hero card (read from the image): BLACKBEARD, RANGED, START HEALTH 13, MOVE 2; PRIVATEER TURNED PIRATE; sidekick SEA DOGS, MELEE, x2, start health 1 each (unmatched-memory spells the name 'Seadog'; the card says SEA DOGS). Values, boosts and copies of the 30 cards agree with unmatched-memory.
